findings.title: Plants that share a name are merged into one row in the stats table, credited to one variety
findings.expected: Two plants with the same name (varieties Red 111 g and Yellow 222 g) each get their own row with their own weight, consistent with the Best plants list
findings.actual: One row 'Twin · Red 333 g' combines both plants' harvests; the Yellow plant has no row, while Best plants on the same page lists Yellow 222 g and Red 111 g separately (query groups by p.name instead of p.id)

findings.title: A malformed or incomplete stats response crashes the page and leaves it stuck on 'Loading stats…' with the previous range's data
findings.expected: A visible error message and no uncaught exception
findings.actual: Uncaught TypeError 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')'; the status line stays 'Loading stats…' while the old range's table and best plants remain on screen; same for empty-object and empty-list responses
